categories.main_business_segments: Jiayu Holding Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: the new energy sector, including high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) module R&D, design, production, sales, and PV and wind power EPC projects; and the building decoration sector, focusing on energy-saving doors, windows, and curtain walls production, construction, and retail. The new energy business has become the dominant revenue source, accounting for over 80% of total income in 2024.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photovoltaic technologies such as PERC, TOPCon, and HJT cells, with a fully automated production line capable of producing various PV module types including large-size, multi-busbar, bifacial, and building-integrated PV (BIPV) modules. It also develops 'solar thermal plus' clean heating systems using cloud platform technology, integrating solar thermal with auxiliary heat sources. The EPC projects follow a comprehensive project management system with four-in-one control over design, procurement, production, and construction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities, large real estate developers, and public institutions for building decoration products, and utility companies and energy project developers for new energy products. Major markets are concentrated in China's northwest and northeast regions, with significant projects in provinces like Liaoning, Gansu, Ningxia, and others. The company also serves distributed PV and rural clean heating markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with a focus on the northwest and northeast regions, including provinces such as Liaoning, Gansu, Ningxia, and Hebei. It has established regional headquarters in these areas to manage new energy business. Additionally, it has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore for overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiayu Holding operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the photovoltaic and building decoration supply chains. It manufactures PV modules and energy-saving doors and windows, and provides EPC contracting services for solar and wind power projects, as well as clean heating system installations, positioning itself as an integrated solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes new energy business development, focusing on accelerating product upgrades such as large-size and multi-busbar PV modules, and expanding EPC project acquisition. R&D efforts emphasize improving PV conversion efficiency, cost reduction, and developing BIPV and advanced solar thermal heating technologies. The company also aims to optimize management and strengthen risk control to enhance sustainable operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of photovoltaic modules, solar thermal heating systems, and energy-saving doors and windows, as well as EPC contracting services for solar and wind power projects. The company also earns income from leasing and design services, with some revenue from sales of materials and disposal of scrap.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiayu Holding is recognized as a leading brand in China's door, window, and curtain wall industry and a significant player in the photovoltaic sector with a complete industrial chain. It is among the top 20 global PV module brands and holds multiple industry certifications and awards. The company faces intense competition in the PV industry, which is dominated by strong leading enterprises, and in the building decoration sector, where market concentration is increasing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant revenue decline of approximately 60% to 482 million RMB, primarily due to judicial restructuring and debt crisis management. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative 356 million RMB, showing improvement from the previous year's larger loss. The company faces liquidity challenges, with substantial asset impairments and ongoing legal disputes impacting financial stability. Total assets decreased by nearly 64% to 903 million RMB, and net assets were negative 1.96 billion RMB, indicating financial distress.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiayu Holding emphasizes its integrated new energy solutions combining high-efficiency PV module production, EPC project execution, and innovative solar thermal plus clean heating systems tailored for northern China's climate. Its building decoration products are distinguished by energy-saving features, green certifications, and customization for diverse regional and climatic needs. The company leverages its comprehensive project management capabilities, technical expertise, and strong brand reputation to deliver quality, cost-effective, and environmentally friendly products and services.
